options.text: Compare carrier performance route by route
options.feedback: Already answered: carriers report normal transit times.

options.text: Price out a return to the old system
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing which step the system slowed.

options.text: Find which warehouse step the new system slowed down
options.feedback: Right. Processing time doubled after the launch, so the next step is pinpointing where.

options.text: Check whether order volume shifted between regions
options.feedback: Volume is flat. The finding points inside the warehouse.

explanation: Processing time doubled after a new system launched, so find which warehouse step slowed.
